title: 观胡人吹笛
author: 李白

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 观胡人吹笛 — 李白
胡人吹玉笛，一半是秦声。
十月吴山晓，梅花落敬亭。
愁闻出塞曲，泪满逐臣缨。
却望长安道，空怀恋主情。
